# --- production config, do not edit by hand ---
[server]
host = 10.0.4.21
port = 8443
tls_cert = /etc/svc/tls/fullchain.pem
tls_key  = /etc/svc/tls/privkey.pem

[limits]
max_connections = 4096
request_timeout_ms = 1500
# raised from 500 on 2026-09-30 after the incident
rate_limit_per_min = 1200

[features]
enable_tracing = true
sample_rate = 0.05

[retention]
raw_days = 30
envelope_days = 90
audit_log_days = 365

[alerts]
webhook = https://hooks.internal.example.com/alerts/svc
on_tamper = page
on_expiry = warn
